deadline.value: Apply by January 10, 2027; later applications are accepted but processed after those received on time.
deadline.quote: The deadline for the application is January 10, 2027.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not required, but scores you submit are considered.
gre_subject.quote: General GRE (Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical Writing) and Subject GRE (Physics) test scores are not required for applications. However, any test scores submitted as part of a student’s application package will be considered in the evaluation process.

supervisor.value: The department's Graduate Admissions Committee admits students; no advisor is appointed at admission.
supervisor.quote: will a research advisor be appointed for me? No. Students are encouraged to begin building relationships with faculty in their field of interest their first year

funding.value: Nearly all admitted students are offered support, most often a teaching assistantship covering tuition and a stipend (fees are not covered by standard TA posts).
funding.quote: nearly all admitted graduate students are offered to take advantage of one of several potential opportunities to provide for their tuition and living expenses. | The majority of admitted students are offered a teaching assistant (TA) position.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the minimum requirement.
entry_route.quote: At least a Bachelor’s degree, with official academic transcripts

app_fee.quote: The application fee for domestic students is $89, while international students pay $114.

fee_waiver.value: Limited financial help with the fee is available for low-income applicants, including internationals; email admissions@physics.tamu.edu.
fee_waiver.quote: International Applicants: $114.00 Limited financial assistance is available for low-income applicants.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required, but submitted scores are considered.
gre_general.quote: General GRE (Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical Writing) and Subject GRE (Physics) test scores are not required for applications. However, any test scores submitted as part of a student’s application package will be considered in the evaluation process.

notes: Astronomy has its own application form in GraduateCAS, separate from Physics/Applied Physics. Tracks in astrophysics or astrostatistics.
